stories.title: AI agents are ready to run your life. Do you trust them?
stories.sum: Tech firms like Meta are betting users will embrace AI agents, even though they have shown they aren't always aligned with our interests.

stories.title: Meta's Muse Is Better at Surveilling Than Helping Me
stories.sum: The Muse app continues Meta’s trend of opting users into data collection for AI training. It also nudges you to share your bank account, email, and passport information.

stories.title: Truck driver’s 800,000-piece model of NYC draws big crowds to museum
stories.sum: When the project was complete, his daughter persuaded him to share the sprawling basement creation on TikTok

stories.title: Big Tech uses guarantees to keep $300bn AI exposure off balance sheets
stories.sum: Wall Street finds new way to turn tech giants’ credit strength into cheaper funding for AI build-out
